descriptionPlain:
About Termius
Termius is a cross-platform SSH client used by millions of engineers worldwide. Secure synchronization keeps hosts, credentials, and settings available across desktop and mobile devices, helping engineers access and manage remote systems from anywhere.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer to maintain and evolve Termius Desktop. You’ll work with context, not control, and lead complex engineering work from investigation to production, communicating openly and seeking candid feedback along the way.
description:
About Termius

Termius is a cross-platform SSH client used by millions of engineers worldwide. Secure synchronization keeps hosts, credentials, and settings available across desktop and mobile devices, helping engineers access and manage remote systems from anywhere.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Engineer to maintain and evolve Termius Desktop. You’ll work with context, not control, and lead complex engineering work from investigation to production, communicating openly and seeking candid feedback along the way.

lists.content:
• Build and evolve product experiences using React and TypeScript.

  • Investigate issues involving synchronization, data integrity, local state, connectivity, and performance.

  • Improve the desktop foundation, including Electron, native dependencies, application updates, and cross-platform behavior.

  • Work across process, storage, network, and OS boundaries when needed.

• Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and complex production applications.
  • Strong debugging, testing, and system-design skills.
  • Comfort navigating a large existing codebase and improving it incrementally.
  • Pragmatic product judgment and clear communication.
  • Strong written English.

    Experience shipping desktop or other locally installed software is preferred; familiarity with Electron, native modules, C++, networking, SSH, cryptography, or OS-specific integrations is a plus, but not required.

    Our stack includes React, TypeScript, Electron, Node.js, Redux, Redux Saga, xterm.js, Jest, Storybook, Playwright, Sentry, and native C++ modules.

    •

• Remote work from time zones between GMT+4 - GMT+12.

  • Relocation support to Auckland, New Zealand.

  • Hardware and accessories for a productive work environment.

  • Paid vacation, sick leave, and flexible time off.

descriptionPlain:
About Termius
Termius is redefining how engineers interact with remote systems. Millions of engineers and thousands of companies rely on Termius worldwide.
While AI has transformed modern IDEs, terminals remain largely unchanged since the 1970s. As a leading cross-platform SSH client, our mission is to boost productivity and foster collaboration by rebuilding the Terminal for the modern era.
We’re looking for a product-minded Rust Engineer to join and strengthen our team. This is a great opportunity to be part of an important new technical direction for the company and work with Rust and tackle complex systems.

lists.content:
• You will play a key role in designing the architecture of a brand-new product from its earliest stages
  • You will bring your Rust expertise to the team, helping establish best practices and raising the engineering bar
  • You will help define how logic is shared across platforms: a fundamental shift in how we build software
  • Your expertise will influence the entire engineering team. You’ll act as a multiplier, not just an executor
  • We value transparency, ownership, and fast decision-making
  • We build for engineers and aim to make complex things simple and elegant
